certificate.model_scope: continuous frozen tetrahedral body versus MuJoCo convex collision solids
limitations: Does not predict deformation, friction, grasp retention or contact forces.
Robot convex envelopes can overestimate nonconvex native collision surfaces.
Left pose is fixed at measured q; native affine compliance and future tracking are not included.
Only the declared straight translation segment is certified; other segments and obstacles require separate gates.
The certificate is for frozen-shape Cartesian translation, not continuous FK tracking of an interpolated joint trajectory.
A fresh actual-shape check remains necessary after physical preparation.

scope: Frozen actual tetra-volume continuous translation against all nonbase left robot convex collision envelopes, measured individual left fingers. No full-section screen, rigid IK route or dynamics performed.
limitations: A clear result is a conservative frozen-geometry separation certificate; blocked convex envelopes do not establish observed native contact forces.
The finite tested offsets do not establish infeasibility of every possible correction in the continuous search region.
